name: AthenaBench-Mini
intro: AthenaBench-Mini 是从 8,100 题完整 AthenaBench 中抽取的 950 题网络威胁情报基准，覆盖 CTI 知识测试、攻击技术枚举、根因映射、风险缓解、漏洞严重性预测和威胁组织归因六类任务。作者以任务特定比例生成 10 个候选子集，并选择整体模型表现最接近完整基准的随机种子。
org: Rochester Institute of Technology, Athena Security Group
build_method: 权威 CTI 与实时漏洞数据整合, GPT-5 生成与双模型筛查, 人工修订, 代表性分层抽样
metric: 准确率（CKT/ATE/RCM/TAA）, 多标签 F1（RMS）, 归一化 MAD 准确率（VSP）, Combined Score
eval_feature: 六类 CTI 任务, 动态威胁数据, 多指标评分, 完整集排名保持抽样
build_method_en: Authoritative CTI and live vulnerability data integration, GPT-5 generation with two-model screening, human repair, representative stratified sampling
eval_feature_en: Six CTI tasks, dynamic threat data, multi-metric scoring, full-benchmark ranking-preserving subset selection
intro_en: AthenaBench-Mini is a 950-item cyber-threat-intelligence benchmark selected from the 8,100-item full AthenaBench. It covers CTI knowledge testing, attack-technique enumeration, root-cause mapping, risk mitigation, vulnerability-severity prediction, and threat-actor attribution; ten task-rate-specific candidate subsets are generated and the seed whose aggregate model performance most closely matches the full benchmark is retained.
scale_en: 950 items (CKT 300, ATE 100, RCM 200, RMS 100, VSP 200, TAA 50)
metric_en: Accuracy (CKT/ATE/RCM/TAA), multi-label F1 (RMS), normalized MAD accuracy (VSP), combined score
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2511.01144 Sections 3-5 and the official AthenaBench repository: authoritative MITRE ATT&CK, CWE, CAPEC, CISA, STIX/TAXII, GDPR, NVD/CVE/CVSS, APT-report, and security-blog inputs; GPT-5 generation of five-option CKT questions for experienced CTI analysts; GPT-5 plus Gemini flagging followed by human inspection; six full-benchmark task counts totaling 8,100; task-specific Mini rates of 10% for CKT/RCM/VSP, 20% for ATE/RMS, and 50% for TAA; ten random seeds with selection by closest aggregate model performance to the complete benchmark; the exact 950-item Mini breakdown; evaluation of 12 proprietary and open-source LLMs at temperature zero where supported; task accuracy for CKT/ATE/RCM/TAA, multi-label F1 for RMS, CVSS parsing with normalized 1 - MAD / 7.7 for VSP; and a uniform-percentage combined score.
